name: Marion County, IA
findings: Marion County has 189 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Marion County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Marion County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Marion County list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 20 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
